title: Request that words which are copied & pasted (or using middle click) into the dictionary widget are immediately looked up without needing to press enter
line: Pasting a word into the Dictionary widget now shows its definition right away, without pressing Enter.
explanation: The Dictionary widget's search field only started a lookup on Enter (onAccepted), so a pasted word just sat there. The field now also looks the word up when a text change inserts more than one character at once (paste, middle click, drop), taking a replaced selection into account; typing a character, deleting and Enter behave as before.

commits.message:
applets/dict: look up pasted words right away

Pasting a word into the Dictionary widget did nothing until Enter was
pressed. When several characters arrive at once, as with paste, middle
click or drop, the word is now looked up immediately; typing is unchanged.

BUG: 515039

media.caption: Master: 'serendipity' pasted with Ctrl+V, nothing is looked up
With the fix: the same paste shows the definition immediately

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right place that directly fulfills the wishlist request for the Dictionary widget without hammering dict.org on partial keystrokes. Tracking previousLength and previousSelectionLength handles paste, middle-click, and drop insertions (including replacing selected text) while leaving typing, deleting, Enter, and clearing unchanged. Before/after screenshots and verification notes confirm the behavior accurately.
